name: Never Enough
plainLyrics:
Ek baar karoon toh ye bolenge hai luck
Do baar karoon phir bhi karenge ye shak
Teen baar karoon but it's never enough
Isliye baar baar karoon 'cause I never give up
Kyunki ek baar karoon toh ye bolenge hai luck
Do baar karoon phir bhi karenge ye shak
Teen baar karoon but it's never enough
Isliye baar baar karoon 'cause I never give up

Yeah
Raaste the band saare, still I found a way
Kabhi lucky na tha main, 'cause I never caught a break
Kaafi label waale mile mujhe, lage bahut hi fakе
Inka formula tha ek, jo ke kare copy pastе
Aaj ye karein aise rap 'cause you know I paved the way
Made them up their pen game, but they'll never really say
Mujhe credit nahin denge, no flowers in my face
Kabhi rap ka hoga craze, I just used to count the days
Never thought I'd make money, make money, money, money
Make money from the game, now there's dollars in my name
For my brothers, I'm the same, kabhi hua nahin change
Mere bade the ye aim, but it never was the fame
Now, let me be honest, toh I was never treated fairly
Underground waalo ko kabhi pasand nahin tha main bhi
Community waale puraane never really cared, see
Khada tha akela, maine khel single player hi (Yeah)
You can take away my accolades, I tackle it
Chheeno meri plate, dedo hate, still I handle it
Bulaao mujhe mid, even if my skill immaculate
Kisi ke liye average even if I'm a maverick
KR$NA never gave up the pen or the paper (Yeah)
Liya jo bhi liya, mujhe diya nahin koi favour (Yeah)
Poochhe mujhse label, what I brought to the table
Jawab hoga kewal, I brought the fuckin' table

Ek baar karoon toh ye bolenge hai luck
Do baar karoon phir bhi karenge ye shak
Teen baar karoon but it's never enough
Isliye baar baar karoon 'cause I never give up
Kyonki ek baar karoon toh ye bolenge hai luck
Do baar karoon phir bhi karenge ye shak
Teen baar karoon but it's never enough
Isliye baar baar karoon 'cause I never give up

Jitna bhi badhoge tum aage, kheechenge ye taange
Tumhe denge saare taane, poore time (Yeah)
Jitna bhi naam tu kama le
Ye baithe tere kaam mein bas khaamiyaan nikaale aur
Jitna bhi main karoon it will never be enough (Huh)
Aur jitna mujhe mila, they be tellin' me it's luck (Luck)
Bahut enemies hai par na enemies se dar
Kyonki jab main on the track, another felony occurs (Brr)
Respect kari earn, I just waited for my turn
Then stepped on the gas, just watchin' the rubber burn
Jaake kar aa bada kaam par kabhi na madad maang
Kyunki aaj kadardaan khode kal kabar, jaan
Mere daale kitne hours on hours, repeat
They deny me my flowers, that's how it just be
Chaahe ghaav ho ya takleef, I don't bow in defeat
Mere daav pe naseeb, na tod paaoge belief
Jaise kawad ke feet, I walked hours in heat
And scoured to reach on this tower, this peak
I say bon appetite, jaise daawat pe jeebh
Got the power to eat and devour the beat (Yeah)
Know this shit ain't breezy, brother
Baat karna aasaan, it's easy, brother
Suna maine you been talkin' greazy par
Gaali dene se pehle laga le DP, brother (Yeah)

Ek baar karoon toh ye bolenge hai luck
Do baar karoon phir bhi karenge ye shak
Teen baar karoon but it's never enough
Isliye baar baar karoon 'cause I never give up
Kyonki ek baar karoon toh ye bolenge hai luck
Do baar karoon phir bhi karenge ye shak
Teen baar karoon but it's never enough
Isliye baar baar karoon 'cause I never give up (Give up)
